split.predicate: SHA256(version:family-and-related-view-group), first8bytes little-endian modulo4; bucket0 unused-validation, otherscalibration

phase.near_goal: exact legal distance<=2 eitherplayer; not inferred from learned value
phase.sparse_strata: no pooled fallback to permit cuts; report NOT_CALIBRATED

regression.fit: calibration groups only; group-equal leastsquares or robust alternative preregistered before collection
regression.interval: separate lower/upper prediction tails including coefficient uncertainty; family-heldout tail validation, normality not assumed
regression.multiple_depth_checks: confidence budget across check depths, sides, phases predeclared; desired error bound requires next allocation
regression.cuts: upper-cut only validated lower predicted deep>=beta; lower-cut only validated upper predicted deep<=alpha
regression.activation: OFF until current binding, fit, unused false-cut coverage and caller cost demonstrated; correlation alone insufficient

TT.ON_cuts: tag directional approximate lower/upper, never promote exact; separate namespace

validation.CI: group-level two-sided tail/false-cut uncertainty with cohort dependence; heldout clusters not row-independent
validation.samewall: requires later OFF/ON caller outcome/cost, not fit residual alone

future_pilot_ESTIMATE_NOT_AUTHORIZATION.input: mechanical target-free existing full-history families, 32 distinct groups, fixed shallow/deep1/2 initially; family split independent of score
future_pilot_ESTIMATE_NOT_AUTHORIZATION.limits: These are explicit assumptions, not measured. Tiny validation subset cannot certify rare false cuts. Zero errors in n independent groups has one-sided95%upper1-0.05^(1/n); correlations widen uncertainty. Larger unused validation e.g299 independent groups required even for1%one-sided bound withzero errors; two-sided/multiple-strata needmore. No core implementation/calibration/test/adoption complete.
